records.part: Technology refresh of the obsolete Radio Dispatch System with digital components to utilize the JPB fiber network and the digital VoIP phones
records.reason: This project is to perform a technology refresh of the obsolete Radio Dispatch System with digital components to utilize the JPB fiber network and the digital VoIP phones.

records.part: New VHF network including new sites co-located with PTC sites and upgrades to several existing VHF sites for Migration to Digital Voice Radio
records.reason: The project is to implement a new network that enhances coverage along the track. The new VHF (Very High Frequency) network includes new sites co-located with the PTC sites, along with upgrades to several existing VHF sites.

records.part: Design to connect JPB fiber backbone to Stations, Caltrain digital voice radio base stations at PTC sites, existing VHF sites at the tunnel, and the Central Control Facility/Back-Up Central Control Facility
records.reason: The project planned to build a design to connect the JPB fiber backbone to the Stations from 4th and King to Tamien, Caltrain digital voice radio base stations located at Positive Train Control (PTC) sites, existing Very High Frequency (VHF) Sites at the tunnel and the Central Control Facility/Back-Up Central Control Facility.

records.part: Add Stadler EMU into existing PADS; modernize and virtualize the Xgate virtual server to provide server redundancy between SJCC and MPCC; PADS improvements including arrival prediction accuracy and GTFS real-time feed
records.reason: The objectives of this project are to 1) develop technical requirements for future PADS Modernization Program.; 2) add Stadler EMU into existing PADS; and 3) modernize and visualize the Xgate virtual server to provide server redundancy between SJCC and MPCC.
